name: reclaimd
description: macOS disk-space analysis tool — annotated, human-reviewed reclaim recommendations. Never deletes; emits commands for a human to run.

scripts.raycast:dev: npm run raycast:prepare && npm --workspace packages/raycast exec -- ray develop -t release
scripts.raycast:build: npm run raycast:prepare && npm --workspace packages/raycast exec -- ray build -e dist -t release
